decisions.decision: Phase 1 uses a three-plan sequence: verified example tracer/timeline, microphone lifecycle and score-position recovery, then accessible controls/browser verification.
decisions.rationale: Independent review required live provisional observations to be generated and tested, then recommended separating accessibility work to keep scopes bounded.

decisions.decision: Initial and recovery count-ins play clicks only during count-in, accent beat one with a distinct tone at approximately the same volume, and add no separate sing-now cue.
decisions.rationale: Locked in the phase discussion; preserve D-01 through D-03.

decisions.decision: An original in-repository vocal exercise and fixed audio-clock behavior are planning recommendations, not user-approved decisions.
decisions.rationale: The example score and singer pause/divergence behavior were left open during discussion; execution must preserve their explicitly provisional status or seek approval if scope changes.
